description: A shortened computerized Raven's Progressive Matrices assessment developed by Mattingly Jameson K MD et al.
title: Abbreviated 12-item Raven's Progressive Matrices assessment

description: The AARP is an eight-item Likert-scaled assessment developed by Tarnowski and Simonian to measure the acceptability of treatments.
title: Abbreviated Acceptability Rating Profile (AARP)

description: A structured clinical framework for assessing and initially stabilising critically ill patients by sequentially evaluating airway, breathing, circulation, disability, and exposure.
title: ABCDE immediate life support methodology

description: A checklist-based assessment tool developed for systematic chest-radiograph interpretation using the Airway, Breathing, Circulation, Disability, and Exposure mnemonic, developed by Yepes-Velasco Andres Felipe et al.
title: ABCDE systematic CXR interpretation checklist

description: An immersive Unity-based virtual-reality application developed for self-instructed practice of systematic ABCDE clinical observation by novice medical and nursing learners.
title: ABCDE VR application

description: ABRACADABRA is a publicly available web-based literacy program developed for elementary students, including those with or at risk for reading difficulties, and provides customizable activities in phonological awareness, phonics, vocabulary, comprehension, and fluency.
title: ABRACADABRA (A Balanced Approach for Children Designed to Achieve Best Results for All)

description: Absence Reports is an attendance-focused intervention delivered by school districts to provide absence information and support improved student attendance.
title: Absence Reports

description: Abstrackr is a natural-language-processing-assisted software tool for supporting systematic-review evidence-synthesis workflows, including study screening, developed for research teams.
title: Abstrackr

description: A 30-item, four-choice scale developed by Abu Latifa to assess decision-making skill in sixth-grade primary students, with responses scored across four decision-making levels.
title: Abu Latifa's (2006) decision-making skill scale for sixth-grade primary students
